name: SP Creator
description: Place your own startpos in any online level, with a short auto part before you take control

language.name: Language
language.description: Language of the mod's messages and SP list. <cy>Auto</c> follows the Windows language.

storage.name: SP storage
storage.description: SPs and versions of all levels, the biggest first: pick what you don't need and delete it.

place-sp.name: Place SP
place-sp.description: Place an SP where you are now. Starting from it replays the last <cy>auto part length</c> seconds of your run, then gives you control here.

switcher.name: SP switcher keys
switcher.description: Switch SPs with the two keys below. Other startpos switchers see the SPs too: turn this off if you switch with one of them.

prev-sp.name: Previous SP
prev-sp.description: Restart from the previous SP (or the level start)

next-sp.name: Next SP
next-sp.description: Restart from the next SP (or the level start)

delete-sp.name: Delete SP
delete-sp.description: Delete the SP you start from and restart from the previous one (or the level start)

auto-part-length.name: Auto part length
auto-part-length.description: Seconds the mod plays for you before handing over control. Applies to SPs placed after the change.

block-input.name: Block control in the auto part
block-input.description: On: your clicks in the auto part are ignored until it ends. Off: your first click ends the auto part and you play from there.

checkpoint-interval.name: Checkpoint interval
checkpoint-interval.description: Physics steps (240 per second) between hidden checkpoints. Lower: the auto part is closer to its set length. Higher: less work while you play.

guide-player.name: Guide the auto part
guide-player.description: Put the player back on the recorded path every step of the auto part, in case the replay drifts
